sources.entry: authentik | Identity provider with SSO, MFA, OAuth2, SAML and LDAP

summary.one_liner: authentik is an open-source identity provider (IdP) for single sign-on, supporting SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, RADIUS and more.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes authentik as an open-source Identity Provider for modern SSO, supporting SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, and RADIUS. It is designed for self-hosting, from small labs to large production clusters. Installation options named in the README are Docker Compose (recommended for small or test setups), a Kubernetes Helm chart (for larger setups), AWS CloudFormation templates, and a DigitalOcean Marketplace one-click app. The README also points to developer documentation for local build environments and contribution process. It states that an enterprise offering exists for organizations replacing IdPs such as Okta, Auth0, Entra ID, and Ping Identity. The README excerpt does not itself detail MFA or the feature set beyond the protocols listed.
use_cases: identity provider for OIDC or SAML apps
managing user identities for a lab or enterprise cluster
how_to_run: Docker Compose: recommended for small/test setups (see the documentation)
Kubernetes: install via the Helm chart (see the documentation and Helm chart repository)
AWS: deploy using the official CloudFormation templates (see the documentation)
DigitalOcean: one-click deployment from the official Marketplace app
notable: Supports SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, and RADIUS in one identity provider
Scales from small labs to large production clusters
Multiple deployment paths: Compose, Helm, AWS CloudFormation, DigitalOcean one-click
Offers an enterprise edition aimed at replacing Okta, Auth0, Entra ID, and Ping Identity
caveats: An enterprise offering exists alongside the open-source edition; the README does not detail which features are enterprise-only
The README excerpt does not specify hardware requirements or detailed setup steps; it points to external documentation
